documentation.content:
# F-02: smk-search

Search SMK; only public-domain records with images

```json
{
  "id": "smk-search",
  "provider": "SMK",
  "kind": "artwork-search",
  "example": {
    "q": "cat",
    "limit": "3",
    "offset": "0"
  },
  "description": "Search SMK; only public-domain records with images",
  "path": "/api/smk-search",
  "documentationPath": "/services/smk-search/F-02.md",
  "healthPath": "/services/smk-search/health",
  "cacheNamespace": "minicurator-v1/smk-search",
  "freshSeconds": 3600,
  "url": "https://yoyo-x402-minicurator.accessible-trip.workers.dev/api/smk-search",
  "exampleUrl": "https://yoyo-x402-minicurator.accessible-trip.workers.dev/api/smk-search?q=cat&limit=3&offset=0",
  "network": "eip155:84532",
  "asset": "0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e",
  "seller": "0x303782B1b788527bE6cC28C6F16aA2A3Ba26b59f",
  "priceAtomic": "1000",
  "scheme": "exact",
  "x402Version": 2,
  "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300
}
```

GET only. Parameters occur once; unknown parameters are rejected. q: 1..80 characters; limit: 1..10 (default 5); offset: 0..1000 (default 0). Detail requires id. met-search additionally accepts departmentId. met-departments accepts no query parameters.

Unpaid: 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Paid success: 200 + PAYMENT-RESPONSE + X-Request-Id. Result envelope: {requestId, resource}. resource contains service, provider, kind, query, sourceUrl, retrievedAt, total, returned, excluded, items, cache. Search totals include excluded records; returned is the actual delivered count.

Met search IDs and artist artwork references have rightsVerified=false; purchase artwork detail before displaying an image. Artwork resources only deliver explicitly CC0/public-domain works with HTTPS museum image/source URLs. Empty filtered search results are valid and still cost one call. Missing/closed/malformed detail returns an error before settlement.

Cache namespace: minicurator-v1/smk-search. Fresh: 3600s; maximum retained age: 7 days. Stale fallback explicitly carries cache.stale=true and original retrievedAt. No image binaries are proxied.

One signature and one paid submission per purchase. Never automatically repeat an unknown payment outcome. Inspect authorization, settlement and chain evidence first.

Full service documentation: https://yoyo-x402-minicurator.accessible-trip.workers.dev/F-02.md

reconciliation.reason: Retry only if unused, expired, balances unchanged and no related transfers
